title: Sacrifice on b8
setup: Black's king has just fled the knight's check into the corner, with its own pawns on a7 and b7.
hint: The knight on a6 already guards b8 — what does that let a queen do on a square right beside the king?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qb8+}} is immune, because the knight on a6 defends b8, so {{Rxb8}} is the only move on the board and the corner is sealed by Black's own rook. {{Nc7#}} then checks from a square no black piece watches. The same sacrifice works in either corner.
